translations.overview: The small city of Tarker's Mills is startled by a series of sadistic murders. The population fears the work of a maniac, but sightings of a mysterious, hairy creature soon spread. People lock themselves up at night, but there's one boy who's still outside…
translations.tagline: It started in May. In a small town. And every month after that whenever the moon was full...It came back.
